oracle.environment: Owned loopback-only child with Clipsal interface access; disposable database-only projects; the only opened CNI endpoint was a loopback synthetic PCI simulator; no site project, hardware or LAN endpoint.

comparison: Replies are exact after <oid>, <timestamp> and <simulator> normalization. Steps marked setup build state and are not compared across servers.

native_facts.route_graph: A route edge N->A exists when database network N holds a Unit at address A whose UnitType starts with BRIDGE or contains GATE (case-sensitive) and network A exists. Network InterfaceType/InterfaceAddress are not consulted. Edges are directional.
native_facts.route_bound: A route holds at most six networks after the local one; the first shortest path in database Unit enumeration order wins.
native_facts.export_local: CGL EXPORT's network list only selects localNetwork: the last project network (project order) in the list. All networks reachable from it are exported in project order, with their route unless local. An empty selection is 408 Local address is missing.
native_facts.export_shape: Applications 0..254 and groups 0..254 are exported; levels 0..255. type keeps 25, 172, 173, 192, 202, 203, 205, 206, 208, 213, 223, 224, 228 and 251; every other application exports as 56. Empty arrays are omitted, null names are written as null, and numberOfExportedObjects counts applications, groups and levels but not networks.
native_facts.import_routes_ignored: Document routes are never compared with C-Gate's route; they are only echoed after the local network in the unroutable diagnostic.
native_facts.import_skip: A network absent from the project is SKIPPED as not existing; an existing network not reachable from localNetwork is SKIPPED as not routable; either makes the final reply 380 CGL import not completed. localNetwork need not exist.
native_facts.import_names: Only missing tag objects receive the document name. Network names and application types are never imported. Progress lines echo the document name even for preserved objects.
native_facts.import_runtime_layer: Created lines follow the union of a volatile runtime layer and the tag database: after a project load, applications and groups are reported again.
native_facts.import_levels: Levels are created with Value equal to their address.
native_facts.import_coercion: JSON follows Jackson defaults: unknown properties are 400, duplicate keys keep the last value, trailing text is ignored, numeric strings and floats coerce to integers, null integers are 0 and scalars coerce to name strings.
native_facts.import_failures: Address, null-entry and null-list failures are 408 and keep every earlier change; version and JSON failures are 400 before any change.
native_facts.nameless: A nameless new tag object imports but makes PROJECT SAVE fail its NOT NULL constraint.
native_facts.configuration: CglImportConfiguration is constructed with defaults for every import; its setters are private and no command syntax reaches them.
native_facts.no_pci: CGL IMPORT and EXPORT change or read only the project label graph and send nothing to the PCI.
